notes:
Account background: RelayShift builds a distributed AI layer for mid-size contact centers — real-time suggestions, guided responses, automated tool-calls (CRM updates, case tagging). They sell to regulated verticals (payments + telco).

Key contact(s): Martin Chen (Head of CX, martin@relayshift.ai) - very focused on latency and reliability; Elena Park (Engineering Director) - infra and security.

Recent timeline: 
- 2025-11-20: inbound via website form, asked about low-latency agent assist for live chat.
- 2025-12-05: discovery call (ff_20260218_4582) - high-level requirements captured.
- 2026-01-12: SE deep-dive w/ Priya - discussed prefix caching, streaming API semantics, and failure modes.
- 2026-02-18: exec demo (recorded, ff_20260218_4582). Demo highlighted streaming suggestions + tool-calls (update CRM, open KB link).
- 2026-03-01: security questionnaire submitted; drive:/RelayShift/security_faq_notes.docx attached.
- 2026-03-04: POC kickoff: agreed scope = 4 weeks, 3 live agent queues, ~120 steady agents, peak ~600 concurrent.

Requirements & constraints (customer language/notes):
- Real-time agent assist: streaming partial suggestions into agent UI; must support backpressure and partial token commits.
- Hard SLO target: median suggestion latency <= 120ms; 95p under 250ms during normal hours. Peak degradation plan for spikes.
- Throughput: target ~20k generated tokens/sec at peak across cluster, ability to scale to 60k tokens/sec for marketing spikes.
- Guardrails: deterministic safety policies, canned-response whitelists, real-time assistant must attach provenance + confidence.
- Tool-calling: prefer pre-authorized micro-actions (crm.updateCase, crm.addNote, kb.open). Need idempotency and observable audit trail.
- Context: per-agent KV cache + per-conversation prefix caching to reduce token usage for repeated prompts.
- Fallbacks: when model variants unavailable, fallback to templated responses with queue-based routing.

Security/compliance notes:
- Require SOC2 + SSO (SAML), enforce KMS for any customer secrets, retention controls per region (US & EU), option for private deployment for high-risk customers.
- Data residency needed for EU customers; RelayShift will push requests to private nodes for EU-resident accounts.

POC success criteria (agreed):
1) Streaming API integration in agent UI delivering incremental suggestions within target latencies for 95% of requests.
2) Tool-calls executed from suggestions with audit logs and retry semantics.
3) No PII leakage flagged by Redwood's evals during 2-week QA.
4) Cost projection that keeps token unit costs within RelayShift's target (40% improvement vs current vendor).

Quotes / call notes: 
- Martin: "If suggestions lag more than 200ms agents will ignore — latency is everything."
- Elena: "We need a predictable scaling plan; our contact centers spike during outages and marketing blasts."

Next steps (short):
- Redwood to provide architecture diagram + infra sizing by 2026-03-08.
- SE (Priya) to hand off streaming integration spec and sample SDK by 2026-03-12.
- Legal to start NDA addendum for VPC/private node options; RelayShift to return signed security questionnaire (follow up JIRA-SEC-214).

Short-term risks: cost model unclear for sustained streaming; procurement timeline (budget runs on fiscal Q2).
